messages:
Alex: Heads up — we need a concise MODEL ENTRY playbook for customer-critical models. Goal: clear acceptance gates, version-lock rules, and a predictable sunset/migration timeline. Customer X is blocked on this. Thoughts?

Mira: +1. Suggest we keep the playbook tiny and operational. Minimum gates: run our 3 core eval suites (QA, summarization, retrieval), end-to-end smoke, and perf checks. Also include a simple comms template for customers.

Sam K: Suggested quantitative gates to start with (we can iterate):
```
EVAL_DELTA >= 0.03 
P95_LATENCY <= 250ms (typical seq len)
ERROR_RATE <= 1%
COST_PER_1K_TOKENS <= $X (region-adjusted)
MIGRATION_NOTICE_DAYS = 30
CANARY_DURATION = 14d
```
Those are initial numbers — open to adjustments per workload.

Jordan P: Love the canary. Add rollback triggers: any absolute quality drop > 0.02 or error spike > 0.5pp over baseline during canary => rollback. Also require a dry-run migration that validates schema/response shape against the adapter.

Alex: Who will own the doc + CS comms? We need the template and a legal-friendly notice for enterprises (Dedicated/Private). @Mira @Sam K are you OK owning split pieces?

Mira: I can draft the customer comms + an internal checklist. Will include a short template for: 1) what changes, 2) expected impact, 3) rollback plan, 4) migration actions for customers. Will also add a checkbox for requiring backwards-compatible output shapes.

Sam K: I'll own the gate definitions, eval harness config, and the actual threshold numbers. I'll add a small test script to run the gates automatically in our CI canary: 
```bash
# run acceptance harness
python infra/tests/run_model_entry_harness.py --model $MODEL --suites core --report out.json
```
Also adding a flag for "version-lock" so customers can opt into stable behavior for N days.

Jordan P: Ops note — platform will need a migration window and the ability to route traffic to a previous model variant for flagged customers. @product-bot can we create a ticket template in the migration board?

product-bot: Created ticket MIG-2029 and linked RFC: https://go/redwood/rfc/1823-model-entry.

Alex: Action items summary:
- Mira: draft comms + internal checklist (owner)
- Sam K: finalize gate numbers + CI harness (owner)
- Alex: coordinate with CS/sales for Customer X and get legal note for enterprise notices
- Jordan P: coordinate infra migration window & routing plan
Target: have a first draft + ticket MR by EOW.

Mira: I'll drop a draft by tomorrow afternoon. Putting the comms template in a short table: 
- Acceptance: eval delta, latency, error
- Ops: canary duration, rollback triggers, migration window
- Customer: notice period, version-lock opt-in

Sam K: Quick Q — do we want a longer grace period for Private customers? Propose 60d for Private/Dedicated and 30d for Hosted.

Alex: That seems reasonable; add as a configurable field in the playbook so PMs can negotiate per contract.

Jordan P: Scheduling a sync Thu 10am PT to walk the doc + infra constraints. If anyone else should be looped in (CS, Sales AE for Customer X), ping here.

Alex: :thumbsup: Thanks all — please add any edge cases to the ticket MIG-2029.
